notes: Single-provider canonical/finalized assertion; not independent consensus validation or a verified complete header chain.

metrics.definition: All executed L1 gas, including rollup settlement transactions; a resource load measure, not user count.

evidence.reason: L1 transaction count is not execution gas.
Daily Mgas/s converted to gas; exact integer/canonical completeness has not been established.

requiredEvidence: Complete canonical UTC block range with integer gasUsed; retain missing blocks and reorg checks. A rounded Mgas/s conversion is a supplement.

metrics.definition: Transactions on an explicitly fixed rollup universe; not distinct people or L1 settlement transactions.

evidence.reason: L1 transactions are not transactions on the fixed rollup universe.

requiredEvidence: Fixed chain identities and transaction inclusion policy for all 28 days; growthepie txcount filters positive gas_price or gas_used in the pinned query. Preserve per-chain missing days.

metrics.definition: Consumed blob gas, with protocol era and capacity changes retained in the source vintage.

requiredEvidence: Integer blobGasUsed for every included canonical block, including zero-blob blocks; retain fork and capacity changes.

metrics.definition: L1 execution fees, base plus priority, excluding blob fees; rollup L1 payments are already included.

evidence.reason: Total fees already include blob fees; the execution/blob split is absent.

requiredEvidence: Sum gasUsed * effectiveGasPrice from execution receipts only; do not relabel total fees including blobs as execution fees.

metrics.definition: Execution base-fee burn, already contained in execution fees.

evidence.reason: Total fees include priority transfers and blobs; they are not execution burn.

requiredEvidence: Per-block baseFeePerGas * gasUsed in exact wei across the canonical UTC window; priority fees are transfers, not burn.

metrics.definition: Blob gas fees only, separate from the execution fee of a blob-carrying transaction.

evidence.reason: The total does not identify its blob component.

requiredEvidence: Exact blobGasUsed * protocol integer blob base fee, or reconciled blob receipt fees, under the applicable fork schedule; TRUNC(EXP(...)) is not the integer fake_exponential algorithm.

metrics.definition: Blob fee burn; equal to blobFeesEth under the cited protocol accounting.

evidence.reason: The total does not identify blob fee burn.

requiredEvidence: A verified blobFeesEth series supports the equal burn amount under the cited rule; equality is not permission to fill an unobserved amount with zero.

metrics.definition: Consensus balance creation less consensus penalties/destruction; excludes deposits, withdrawals and execution fee transfers. May be negative.

evidence.reason: Gross network issuance does not subtract consensus penalties or establish layer accounting.

requiredEvidence: Exact consensus creation minus all consensus destruction for the UTC window, excluding deposits/withdrawals and fee transfers.

Pinned growthepie CL series has theoretical issuance for 2025-05-07 through 2026-01-01, an interpolated participation factor, and a two-day Shapella redistribution; current epoch-normalized hourly means also require boundary reconciliation.

metrics.definition: Ethereum mainnet canonical PoW block, ommer inclusion and ommer beneficiary rewards; excludes transaction fees and consensus issuance. The source receipt must identify the canonical block range, transition boundary and reward rules. Zero requires a sourced protocol-zero receipt, not missing-data imputation. Full UTC windows starting on or after 2022-09-16 must be zero; a mixed transition window retains its actual pre-transition issuance.

evidence.reason: A combined issuance field does not prove a PoW-only value.
Sourced protocol-zero partial observation for the fully post-transition canonical range.

requiredEvidence: Use the existing sourced EIP-3675 post-transition canonical-range receipt; never infer zero from absent IssTotNtv data. Retain provider-only canonical/finalized limitations.

metrics.definition: Total ETH supply across execution and consensus accounting; staking does not subtract from total supply.

evidence.reason: Execution/consensus supply and revision scope remain unreconciled.

requiredEvidence: Reconciled execution plus consensus supply at the exact window end, with deposits/withdrawals as transfers and a revision trail; do not subtract staked ETH.

metrics.definition: Consensus staking balances including pending exits; not assumed economically illiquid if claims trade.

requiredEvidence: All contract-defined staking balances including pending exits at window end. Pinned growthepie active actual balance excludes nonactive balances; its fallback can be effective balance and daily data can use start_balance.

metrics.definition: Subset of stakedEth with queued exits; excludes already withdrawn balances.

requiredEvidence: Validator-status and actual-balance stock at the same end state; exclude withdrawn balances and avoid treating completed exits as the pending queue.

metrics.definition: End-user fees collected by the same rollup universe, each execution/data/operator charge counted once; ETH converted fees require a dated conversion receipt.

requiredEvidence: Same fixed L2 universe as transactions and settlement; execution, data and operator user charges once each; dated native-token conversion where needed.

metrics.definition: That universe paid to L1 execution plus blob fees, a subset of total L1 fees; never added again to executionFeesEth+blobFeesEth.

evidence.reason: No fixed-rollup settlement subset is identified.

requiredEvidence: Same fixed L2 universe and identified L1 settlement transactions; execution plus blob charges exactly once. rent_paid derived views can fill missing dates; obtain missingness/provenance instead of treating all displayed zeroes as observed.

metrics.definition: Gross consensus rewards earned by the fixed staking cohort; not ideal/theoretical reward and not duplicated across total and component API fields.

requiredEvidence: Earned gross rewards for the fixed validator/investor cohort, with disjoint total/component API accounting; net CL rewards or ideal rewards cannot substitute.

metrics.definition: Consensus penalties and slashing destruction borne by that same cohort, as a nonnegative deduction.

requiredEvidence: Actual penalties and slashing destruction of the same cohort; missing penalties are not zero.

metrics.definition: Execution priority fees received by the cohort, separate from issuance and burn.

requiredEvidence: Priority fees actually earned by identified cohort proposers/fee recipients, separate from issuance and other builder payments.

metrics.definition: Measured additional MEV payment to the cohort after removing priority fees already in stakingPriorityFeesEth; unknown decomposition is missing, not zero.

requiredEvidence: Reconciled execution/builder transfers to the same cohort after removing priority fees already counted; unknown decomposition remains missing.

metrics.definition: Actual pool, operator and custody charges to the measured investors; count each charge once.

requiredEvidence: Actual pool/operator/custody charges to those investors, with each expense counted once. A network APR does not provide this field.

metrics.definition: Actual remaining operating costs not already included in service fees; non-ETH expenses require a dated conversion receipt.

requiredEvidence: Actual residual operating expenses and dated non-ETH conversion; never use an assumed APR haircut or zero default.

metrics.definition: Average cohort principal exposed to the recorded rewards/penalties during the window; denominator and all return components share the same cohort.

requiredEvidence: Time-weighted eligible principal for precisely the cohort earning all recorded reward/cost components; a final active-balance stock is not the denominator.

metrics.definition: Number of eligible completed exits underlying the waiting-time statistic; zero does not imply zero waiting time.

requiredEvidence: Count from the fixed sample of exits completed within the UTC window; keep the request and execution-availability event pair.

metrics.definition: Median request-to-execution-availability duration for the completed exit sample. It is not a forecast of pending exits and is completion-selection biased.

requiredEvidence: Median elapsed duration over that same completed sample, not pending-queue clearance time; zero completed exits leaves the median missing.

metrics.unit: unique underlying ETH at window end
metrics.definition: Native and wrapped-native ETH pledged within the fixed collateral universe after deduplicating lending receipts and reused claims.

requiredEvidence: Fixed protocol/asset/chain coverage and backing identifiers at window end; deduplicate ETH/WETH, bridges and lending receipts. Latest USD divided by latest ETH price is not a unique-underlying ledger.

metrics.unit: unique underlying ETH at window end
metrics.definition: ETH backing pledged staking claims after recursive wrapper/receipt deduplication; exclude any backing unit already counted as native collateral.

requiredEvidence: Recursive LST/LRT/wrapper backing units disjoint from native collateral. Subtracting aggregate LST categories does not establish unique underlying units.

nextCollectionSteps.action: Keep raw bytes and immutable receipts from the existing Coin Metrics, throughput and PoW-zero collectors. Replay locally; preserve failures and unknown publication times.

nextCollectionSteps.action: Freeze an explicit research chain list before collection; retain separate per-chain 28-day rows and nulls. Begin with txcount, then reconcile filters and fee components against the same declared scope.
nextCollectionSteps.resultingStatus: source-subset research observations until definition and vintage evidence is complete

nextCollectionSteps.network: one bounded public history response; no key
nextCollectionSteps.action: Inspect exact integer strings, epoch coverage and issuance/penalty field semantics before any accumulation. An epoch crosses UTC boundaries; do not turn hourly means into exact UTC net issuance.
nextCollectionSteps.resultingStatus: raw component audit, not a 28-day net issuance observation

nextCollectionSteps.network: deferred: full 28-day canonical block/receipt enumeration is outside this small collector scope
nextCollectionSteps.action: A later separately bounded collector can sum exact gas, base-fee burn and blob accounting using verified fork parameters and canonical boundaries.

accountingConstraints: executionFeesEth + blobFeesEth is the total; executionBurnEth is a component, not additional fee revenue.
l2SettlementFeesEth is already a subset of total L1 fees; never add it to those total fees.
Epoch-average net CL rewards are neither exact UTC gross rewards nor a cohort return.
Active staking balance is not total staking balance or time-weighted cohort principal.
Native and staking-claim collateral require disjoint unique underlying units, not additive token/TVL headlines.
interpretation: Partial observations and source-definition gaps only. A zero full-snapshot count does not mean zero observations. This inventory never certifies a model input or forecast.

provenance.executionSource: static imports at the inspector source root; repositoryRoot selects input artifacts only
